rationale: Each colour-6 pixel rotates once by (dr,dc)->(-dc,dr) around its nearest colour-1 anchor and becomes 7, leaving background 8. For example, (4,7) moves to (1,4) around (4,4), and (2,12) moves to (4,10) around (4,12). All demonstrated sources align with their nearest anchors, so unrestricted matching suffices.
